  <!-- Reads no property on any list: the guards write under their artifacts folder, the gate does not. -->
  <Target Name="QuietOutsideTheArtifacts" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile" Condition="!$([System.String]::Copy('$(OutDir)').Contains('artifacts'))">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);RS0030</NoWarn>
    </PropertyGroup>
  </Target>
